annotations.text:
Cool direction, confirmed.
Light on the left, dark on the right.

Type: Newsreader (display),
IBM Plex Sans (body),
IBM Plex Mono (metadata + metrics).

About the purple on black:

#7f00e0 on #000 is only 2.98:1 — it fails
even the 3:1 bar, so it cannot be text or a
line in dark mode.

So the brand purple stays as a FILL (the
button, white text on it at 7.05:1), and
anything that must read as text or a line
uses the SAME hue (274°) lifted to
#b657ff — 5.80:1 on black.

Experience and Recommendations carry the
craft budget. Everything else stays quiet.

Experience assumes every impact line
leads with a number.
